title: BC - SC and O - O and G Upstream Ops - Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Manager – Subsurface (O&G Upstream)**
**Desired Experience: 8–10 years**
**Mandatory Skill:**

* O&G Upstream Operations (Field / Production Operations domain depth)

**Preferred Background:**

* Experience with Integrated Oil Companies such as Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP

**Role Purpose**
Upstream Operations Subject Matter Expert (SME) embedded within a digital / AI use case delivery squad, acting as the functional bridge between upstream operations stakeholders and cross-functional technical teams (product, data science, data engineering, architecture). The role is non-coding and focuses on shaping, translating, validating, and governing upstream operations analytics / AI solutions to improve asset profitability, production efficiency, and recovery.
  
  
**Operating Model & Reporting**

* Workstream leadership role within an Agile / product-style delivery environment; responsible for end-to-end functional success of upstream operations use cases from discovery to deployment.
* Interfaces with upstream business teams and technical delivery teams (product managers, data scientists, data engineers, solution architects).
* Reports into Consulting Delivery Leadership and partners closely with MENA stakeholders on SC&O / Digital Ops priorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Upstream Operations Use Case Discovery & Functional Support

+ Lead discovery sessions with upstream operations stakeholders to capture decision workflows, operational pain points, constraints, and success criteria
+ Own the creation of structured documentation: use case descriptions, functional requirements, assumptions, constraints, acceptance criteria, and stakeholder-ready narratives.
+ Define and align upstream operations transformation roadmaps to improve asset profitability, production efficiency, and recovery.

* Digital / AI Use Case Delivery Support (Non-Coding)

+ Translate upstream operations requirements into technical inputs for delivery teams (features, inputs, operational constraints, data definitions/classifications), ensuring feasibility and traceability.
+ Support delivery of upstream operations digital solutions by helping define and validate data and workflow needs, including combining inputs from field planning, operations, and finance for performance optimization
+ Validate analytics outputs, dashboards, and insights against operational realism and operating philosophies; drive iterative improvements with product/data teams.

* Stakeholder Management & Client-Facing Delivery

+ Act as a trusted interface between upstream operations stakeholders and technical delivery teams; sustain credibility through practical workflow understanding.
+ Lead structured feedback cycles (including pilots and phased rollouts) and convert feedback into clear requirements/backlog items.
+ Lead cross-functional engagement and interviews across relevant upstream stakeholders as needed for platform delivery (e.g., field operations interfaces such as drilling/completions/facilities, HSE & emissions, finance/accounting, data infrastructure).

* Governance, Quality & Assurance

+ Support definition of data quality standards, operational assumptions, and validation checkpoints for upstream operations datasets and model outputs.
+ Ensure solutions align with established practices and contribute to documentation, playbooks, and governance artifacts for deployed use cases.
+ Drive UAT planning and execution from a functional lens; confirm outputs are credible and usable for operations decision-making.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 8–10 years of upstream Oil & Gas experience with strong upstream operations / field operations depth.
* Practical experience articulating upstream operations workflows in practice, including operational constraints and data quality considerations.
* Strong communication and structured documentation skills; ability to translate operations concepts clearly to non-engineers and technical teams.
* Demonstrated cross-functional delivery experience spanning operations / engineering / digital teams in Agile delivery environments.
* Fluency in English (mandatory).
* Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines
* MBA
* Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.

**Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

* Exposure to AI, advanced analytics, digital transformation, optimization, or surveillance initiatives in upstream contexts.
* Familiarity with upstream operations / production data sources and reporting environments used for operational performance tracking.
* Arabic language capability (optional).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.
  
  
EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Ticketing Manager
company: Green Oasis Tours & Travels Services P.Ltd
description:
**Company Description**
Green Oasis Tours & Travels Pvt. Ltd is a professionally managed destination management company with over 18 years of experience in the travel and tourism industry, based in Kerala. The company specializes in arranging and managing domestic and international travel, including air tickets, tour packages, lodging, car rentals, cruises, and related services. Green Oasis is committed to providing premier services and innovative travel options that meet both business and leisure travel needs. Its mission is to be the leading travel services provider in Kerala by delivering superior service levels and tailored travel solutions, including medical tourism, Hajj-Umrah services, hotel booking, travel insurance, and visa services.
  
**Role Description**
The Ticketing Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi, responsible for overseeing domestic and international ticketing operations. The role involves managing ticket sales, coordinating bookings and reservations, handling fare calculations, and ensuring accurate issuance and modification of tickets. The Ticketing Manager will liaise with airlines, consolidators, and other partners to secure competitive fares and resolve ticketing-related issues. Daily tasks include supervising ticketing staff, maintaining up-to-date knowledge of airline policies and industry regulations, and ensuring a high standard of customer service throughout the ticketing process. The role also includes monitoring system efficiency, preparing reports on ticketing performance, and supporting the improvement of internal ticketing procedures.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Ticket Sales and Ticket Operations, including booking, issuing, reissuing, and canceling domestic and international tickets.
* Candidates should possess expertise in Event Ticketing and related coordination, ensuring accurate reservation management and smooth ticketing processes.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to interact effectively with customers, airlines, and internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess solid knowledge of GDS/airline reservation systems (e.g., Amadeus, Galileo, Sabre) and basic fare rules, along with proficiency in MS Office tools.
* Relevant experience in travel and tourism ticketing, preferably in an agency or destination management company, and a diploma or degree in Travel & Tourism or a related field is beneficial.
* Candidates should possess strong organizational and time-management abilities, attention to detail, and the capability to work in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

title: Operations Manager Intern
description:
**Location**
: Kalamassery, Kochi, Kerala

**Role Type:**
Internship | Hybrid (Primarily Work From Home)

**Duration**
: 6 months.

**Working Hours:**
11:00 AM – 8:00 PM.

**Monthly Stipend:**
₹5,000.

**Performance Bonus**
: Up to ₹10,000 based on individual performance and achievement of operational targets. The bonus is performance-based and is not guaranteed.

**Joining**
: Immediate.

**About the Role**

Fawrit Technologies is looking for an
**Operations Manager Intern**
to support and coordinate day-to-day operations across our laundry partners, riders, customers, and internal technical team.

The role involves managing operational communication through WhatsApp and other communication channels, monitoring orders, coordinating pickups and deliveries, following up with laundry partners and riders, assisting customers, and ensuring operational issues are followed up and resolved efficiently.

This is a people-facing operations role that requires strong communication, responsiveness, ownership, problem-solving ability, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups simultaneously.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Order & Operations Coordination

* Monitor incoming orders and ensure they move smoothly through the service process.
* Track orders from customer pickup through laundry processing to final delivery.
* Follow up on pending, delayed, or problematic orders.
* Coordinate with partners and riders to ensure timely order completion.
* Keep order information and status updates accurate in the system.
* Identify operational issues and take timely action or escalate them when required.

2. Estimates, Invoices & Payments

* Assist with preparing and sharing estimates with customers when required.
* Share invoices and payment links after confirming the necessary order details.
* Follow up on pending payments when required.
* Ensure payment and order-related information is accurately recorded.

3. Partner Coordination

* Communicate with laundry partners regarding orders, service progress, and operational requirements.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing partners.
* Understand partner concerns, requirements, and operational challenges.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to address partner issues.
* Communicate customer requirements and special instructions to partners.
* Assist with the coordination and onboarding of new partners when required.

4. Customer & Rider Coordination

* Communicate with customers regarding pickups, deliveries, order updates, and service-related queries.
* Coordinate with riders regarding pickup and delivery schedules.
* Communicate customer requests, changes, and important order information to riders.
* Follow up with riders to ensure pickups and deliveries are completed on time.
* Assist in resolving routine customer and rider concerns.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates regarding order status and delays.

5. Internal & Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with the internal technical team regarding operational or system-related issues.
* Clearly communicate reported issues, requirements, and customer or partner concerns.
* Follow up with the relevant team until the issue is addressed.
* Keep the manager updated on important operational issues.
* Escalate customer complaints, partner concerns, payment issues, rider problems, or unusual situations when necessary.

6. Communication & Follow-Up

* Manage multiple WhatsApp conversations and operational requests efficiently.
* Respond to customers and partners in a timely and professional manner.
* Maintain proper follow-up on unresolved issues.
* Ensure important conversations, customer requests, and operational requirements are not missed.
* Maintain accurate records of relevant operational activities.
* Provide regular updates on pending orders, operational challenges, and unresolved issues.

**What We're Looking For**

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple conversations and tasks simultaneously.
* Basic computer and application-handling skills.
* Good attention to detail.
* Problem-solving ability and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to remain calm and professional while handling operational issues.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, riders, and business partners.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Willingness to communicate through WhatsApp and other business communication channels.
* Ability to follow up on tasks independently and ensure issues are addressed.
* Willingness to work primarily from home and attend the Kochi office when required.

**Internship Details**



**Full-Time Opportunity**

Based on individual performance and business requirements, successful interns may be considered for a full-time opportunity upon completion of the internship, with a potential monthly compensation package of
**₹20,000 – ₹40,000**
.

Full-time conversion is not guaranteed and will depend on the intern's performance, demonstrated ownership, ability to handle the role independently, and the company's business requirements at that time.

**Role Objective**

The
**Operations Manager Intern**
will serve as a central coordination point between customers, riders, laundry partners, and the internal team.

The primary objective is to ensure that day-to-day operations run smoothly, communication is handled effectively, operational issues are followed up, and orders move efficiently from pickup to final delivery.

The intern is expected to demonstrate accountability, maintain clear communication, and proactively follow up on operational tasks to support a reliable customer experience.

**Work Location:**
Primarily Work From Home, with occasional in-person attendance at the Kalamassery, Kochi office as required.

title: Production Manager
description:
We are Hiring - Production Manager - Electronics Manufacturing (Kochi)

As a Production Manager, you’ll take ownership of our electronics hardware production, PCB assembly, testing, and team performance. This is a hands-on leadership role, ideal for someone who knows how production really works and enjoys leading people.

Location: Kochi

Salary: Industry standards (based on experience)

* Plan and manage daily production activities for electronics hardware & PCB assembly
* Lead, guide, and motivate the production team
* Coordinate with Stores, QA, Engineering, and Vendors for smooth operations
* Ensure on-time production with high quality and minimal rework
* Resolve production and quality issues quickly and practically
* Improve processes, productivity, and workflow efficiency
* Support automation and better manufacturing practices
* Ensure safety and compliance in the production area
* Report production performance to management

Key Requirements

* Minimum 3+ years of experience in electronics or electrical manufacturing
* Started career at Production Technician / Assembly / Line-level role
* Currently or previously handled a team (Technician Lead / Supervisor / Assistant Manager)
* Experience in: PCB Assembly, Electronics testing & quality checks, BOM handling & component coordination

Education

* B.Tech / Diploma in Electronics or Electrical Engineering

Added Advantage

* Exposure to Lean Manufacturing / Process Improvement / Kaizen

Company Description

Perleybrook Labs Inc is a video analytics company focused on solving complex Safety Engineering and Workforce Management challenges for manufacturing enterprises. Its flagship product, Flagman, is an IoT device with a cloud backend powered by 25 AI algorithms that support diverse use cases in forklift safety, machine safety, and productivity monitoring. The company’s solutions help organizations improve safety through features such as blind spot detection, virtual machine barriers, PPE enforcement, and access control, while also optimizing workforce productivity with attendance tracking and behavior analysis. Headquartered in Portsmouth, New Hampshire, with operations in Kochi, India, Perleybrook Labs serves customers worldwide through a network of distributors and partners.

title: EY- Process and Controls - Risk Consulting -IA Capital Projects - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Process & Controls – Risk Consulting – Manager -IA Capital Projects**
As part of our Risk Consulting, you will be supporting the team in client engagements related to Risk Consulting, Internal Audit, GRC Consulting for various clients across the MENA region. The client base spans across various sectors and includes collaboration with other teams within Consulting services.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for experienced professionals with experience in the Real Estate and Construction sector and Internal Audit/ Risk to join our Process & Controls Team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering. This position will be based out of our offices (Kochi/ Thiruvananthapuram) in the beautiful state of Kerala.
  
  
Working in our practice, you will have the opportunity to work with clients to provide practical risk management, internal audit solutions and gaining valuable experience in a variety of clients.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
The current role requires executing internal audit and other risk consulting engagements for Real Estate construction companies. As part of the role, the candidate is expected to:
  
  

* Responsible for leading and executing client engagements and meeting the expectations of the client and the onsite team within the MENA region.
* Ability to interact with all levels of management, including C-Suite executives.
* Perform end-to-end internal audits from planning to reporting including process understanding, walkthroughs, preparation of risk and control matrix / audit work program, control testing to assess their design and operating effectiveness, preparation of audit report and agreeing issues/ actions with management.
* Have an in-depth understanding of the Real Estate, Capital Projects, and Construction industry risks/issues/trends and end-to-end business processes.
* Demonstrate knowledge and experience of the project delivery (EPC) lifecycle, including understanding of governance structures, organizational design, and Delegation of Authority frameworks.
* Assess business cases for capital projects, analyzing their structure, assumptions, and feasibility.
* Lead audits with engineering, planning, or cost-related components, including review of master planning, engineering phases, stage gate methods, and design maturity.
* Understand cost estimating principles, cost estimate classifications, LPM build-up techniques, and perform BoQ analysis and material take-offs.
* Evaluate procurement, contract, and commercial practices, and apply project control principles (schedule, cost, risk, reporting).
* Analyze integrity, completeness and accuracy of project plans, cost estimates, risk plans, and interpret project documentation such as contracts, reports, and dashboards.
* Review and interpret resource plans and schedules to assess alignment with project objectives.
* Deliver/manage engagements on time, within budget, and at high quality.
* Identify key areas of improvement in the client's business processes and add value through insightful recommendations.
* Contribute to business development activities such as proposal preparation and lead identification.
* Always comply with the firm’s quality and risk management policies.
* Manage multiple assignments and associated project teams.
* Maintain excellent rapport and proactive communication with clients.
* Mentor and coach junior team members, enabling them to meet performance goals and grow their careers.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**Job Title:**
GDS Meetings & Events Sourcing Manager
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The GDS Meetings & Events (M&E) Sourcing Manager will be responsible for the strategic sourcing, contracting and supplier management of hotels, venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies, production houses, transportation providers and other event-related suppliers supporting EY meetings and events globally.
  
  
This role will serve as the subject matter expert for venue and event sourcing, providing commercial guidance and market intelligence to stakeholders while driving value, compliance, cost optimisation and service excellence. The successful candidate will possess strong hospitality industry knowledge, a deep understanding of hotel operations and contracting terminology, and the ability to negotiate complex event agreements across multiple markets. The role will work closely with internal stakeholders, procurement teams, meeting planners and suppliers to deliver sourcing solutions that align with EY's Meetings & Events strategy and policies.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Venue & Supplier Sourcing

+ Lead venue sourcing activities for meetings, conferences, leadership events, training programmes, offsites and client-facing events.
+ Analyse event requirements and develop sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives, budget and attendee experience expectations.
+ Source and evaluate hotels, convention centres, resorts, event venues, destination management companies (DMCs), event agencies and other event suppliers.
+ Conduct market research and benchmark venue rates, supplier capabilities and industry trends to support decision-making.
+ Provide venue recommendations based on location suitability, contractual terms, operational feasibility, attendee experience and commercial value.

* Contract Negotiation & Commercial Management

+ Lead RFP, RFQ and proposal evaluation processes for hotels, venues and event suppliers.
+ Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, concessions and contractual protections to maximise value and mitigate risk.
+ Ensure all supplier agreements comply with EY procurement policies, legal requirements and standard contract templates.
+ Drive savings initiatives through strategic sourcing, preferred supplier utilisation and volume-based negotiations.
+ Support supplier renewals and contract reviews while maintaining a strong supplier governance framework.

* Hospitality & Industry Expertise

+ Serve as the M&E team's subject matter expert on hotel operations, venue management and hospitality contracting.
+ Demonstrate strong knowledge of hotel industry terminology including:

- Guest room blocks and pickup analysis
- Attrition and cancellation clauses
- Food & Beverage minimum commitments
- Meeting room rental structures
- Complimentary ratios and concession strategies
- Revenue displacement and peak period pricing
- Force majeure and risk mitigation clauses
- Commission and non-commission models, and negotiated rate structures

+ Advise stakeholders on hotel operational considerations that impact cost, attendee experience and event success.
+ Maintain knowledge of regional and global hospitality market trends, supplier capabilities and emerging venue solutions.

* Stakeholder Management

+ Partner with meeting sponsors, event planners and business stakeholders to understand sourcing requirements and event objectives.
+ Provide sourcing guidance and recommendations throughout the meeting and event lifecycle.
+ Act as the primary escalation point for venue and supplier-related issues during sourcing and contracting phases.
+ Build strong relationships with key hotel brands, venue operators, event agencies and industry partners.

* Supplier Performance & Governance

+ Monitor supplier performance against contractual service levels and programme expectations.
+ Support supplier onboarding, due diligence and ongoing relationship management activities.
+ Maintain sourcing databases, preferred supplier catalogues and venue intelligence resources.
+ Identify opportunities to enhance supplier performance, improve service delivery and strengthen strategic partnerships.

* Reporting & Process Improvement

+ Analyse sourcing activity, contract performance and savings opportunities through reporting and KPI management.
+ Support compliance monitoring and programme governance initiatives across the M&E function.
+ Drive continuous improvement initiatives to streamline sourcing processes, improve stakeholder experience and enhance programme efficiencies.
+ Own and drive data entry and accuracy on CVENT and contract uploads on ARIBA
+ Support sourcing-related technology platforms, databases and supplier management tools.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, Tourism, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain or a related field preferred.
* Hospitality or procurement-related professional certifications are advantageous.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 – 5 years of experience in hotel sales, venue sourcing, hospitality procurement, destination management, corporate event management or strategic sourcing.
* Strong experience negotiating hotel contracts and managing large-scale venue sourcing projects.
* Experience working with global hotel chains, event agencies and hospitality suppliers.
* Demonstrated knowledge of meetings and events operations and procurement practices.
* Experience working in multinational, matrixed and stakeholder-driven environments is highly desirable.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Strong expertise in hotel, venue and event supplier sourcing, with a deep understanding of hospitality operations and industry terminology.
* Proven contract negotiation, supplier management and procurement experience with a strong commercial mindset.
* Ability to drive cost optimisation, budget management and data-driven sourcing decisions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills across all levels.
* Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving capabilities with attention to detail.
* Ability to build and maintain strategic supplier relationships while working independently in a global, fast-paced environment.

**What We Look For**
We are seeking a commercially minded sourcing professional with deep hospitality industry expertise and a proven ability to negotiate complex event agreements. The ideal candidate will combine strong market knowledge, supplier relationship management and strategic thinking to deliver best-in-class sourcing solutions while supporting EY's global Meetings & Events programme objectives.

title: Credentialing Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Proficio Therapy Services provides pediatric ABA, speech, and occupational therapy designed to support children and families through individualized, compassionate care. Serving communities in California and Utah, including the South Jordan location, the team helps children develop communication, social, behavioral, and daily living skills in a supportive environment. The organization partners closely with families, celebrates progress, and focuses on meaningful outcomes for every child. Services are delivered through specialized programs such as AGES Learning Solutions (ABA services) and Child’s Play (pediatric occupational therapy), ensuring comprehensive support. Proficio Therapy Services is committed to expanding access to quality pediatric therapy and supporting families at every step.

**Role Description**

The Credentialing Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Kochi, responsible for overseeing the end-to-end credentialing and re-credentialing process for clinicians and therapy providers. This role includes preparing, submitting, and tracking credentialing applications with payers and regulatory bodies, maintaining accurate provider records, and ensuring compliance with relevant standards and timelines. The Credentialing Manager will collaborate with clinical, operations, and billing teams to resolve credentialing issues, verify licenses and certifications, and support provider onboarding. Daily tasks involve monitoring expirations, updating internal systems, responding to payer inquiries, and generating status reports for leadership. The role also supports process improvement, develops credentialing procedures, and helps ensure that children and families experience uninterrupted access to care.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in provider credentialing, payer enrollment, and re-credentialing processes, preferably in healthcare or therapy services.
* Strong skills in data management, documentation, and use of credentialing or practice management software.
* Knowledge of regulatory and compliance requirements related to licensing, certifications, and payer contracts.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills for working with clinicians, families, payers, and internal teams.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work on-site in Kochi and coordinate with geographically dispersed teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, or a related field; relevant credentialing or compliance certifications are a plus.
* Prior experience in pediatric or behavioral health settings is beneficial, along with a commitment to family-centered care.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Oracle**
**Fusion - Project Financials**
**Functional -**
**Manager**
**Job Summary:**
We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Project Financials Functional Manager with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience and strong project accounting and financial management expertise. A qualified Chartered Accountant with relevant post-qualification experience is mandatory. The role requires extensive hands-on implementation and leadership experience across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control, including budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, burdening, capitalization, intercompany and interproject processing, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting, period close and reconciliation. The successful candidate will lead functional delivery, solution design, finance stakeholder workshops and project teams while remaining actively involved in configuration, testing, deployment and post-go-live support.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Project Financials implementations, rollouts, upgrades and support engagements, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
* Provide hands-on functional leadership across Project Foundation, Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts and Project Control.
* Analyse project accounting and financial management requirements and map them to standard Oracle Fusion Cloud processes and controls.
* Design project organizations, project units, templates, classifications, expenditure types, transaction sources, burden schedules, rate schedules, budgets, forecasts, billing plans, revenue methods and accounting options.
* Lead cost collection, cost allocation, burdening, capitalization, project asset creation, intercompany and interproject billing, customer invoicing, revenue recognition and project close solution design.
* Lead fit-to-standard workshops, requirement gathering, process design, solution walkthroughs and finance stakeholder sign-offs.
* Prepare and review functional design documents, configuration workbooks, process flows, test scripts, reconciliation templates, training materials and operating procedures.
* Manage integrations with General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM, EPM and external applications.
* Drive CRP, SIT, UAT, data migration, cutover, go-live and hypercare activities, including project cost, revenue, invoice and accounting reconciliation and defect resolution.
* Validate subledger accounting, accounting distributions, period close, project-to-ledger reconciliation and project performance reporting.
* Manage scope, estimates, plans, risks, issues, dependencies, quality, governance and senior stakeholder communication.
* Lead, mentor and review the work of functional consultants while collaborating with finance, technical, integration, data and reporting teams.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Oracle Projects, Project Accounting or Project Financial Management, including substantial hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Financials.
* Qualified Chartered Accountant with relevant post-qualification experience in project accounting, financial control, audit, revenue, costing or management accounting is mandatory.
* Strong implementation and support experience across Project Costing, Project Billing, Project Contracts, Project Control and Project Foundation.
* Deep knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, cost collection, allocations, burdening, capitalization, project assets, invoicing, revenue recognition, accounting, period close and reconciliation.
* Experience in at least three full lifecycle Oracle Projects or Project Financials implementations, including at least two Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
* Proven experience leading Project Financials workstreams, client workshops, solution design, testing, data migration, cutover, period close, reconciliation and post-go-live support.
* Experience with integrations across General Ledger, Receivables, Payables, Fixed Assets, Procurement, Expenses, Time and Labor, HCM and EPM.
* Experience in client-facing delivery, project planning, effort estimation, team management and senior stakeholder communication.
* Experience in project-centric sectors such as engineering and construction, professional services, energy, real estate, oil and gas, government, or power and utilities is preferred.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Strong Oracle Fusion Project Financials functional, project accounting, financial control and team leadership skills.
* Ability to lead Project Financials workstreams independently, work under pressure and meet deadlines.
* Sound understanding of accounting standards, project costing, revenue recognition, capitalization, subledger accounting, period close and financial reconciliation.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate finance and business requirements into functional designs.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, reconciliation, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
* Ability to assess financial process and control implications and apply sound professional judgement.
* Ability to drive delivery governance, quality reviews, release priorities and team development.
* Must have a valid passport for business travel involving work at client sites and be willing to work MENA shift timings (Sunday to Thursday).

**Education:**

* Mandatory qualification: Qualified Chartered Accountant from a recognised professional accounting body, with relevant post-qualification experience.
* Oracle Fusion Cloud Project Management or Project Financial Management certification is preferred.

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Fintech - FDI - Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Manager – FDI**
**EY – GDS – Consulting – Finance**
As a Manager in our EY Finance Consulting Team, you will lead client engagements focused on leveraging finance data intelligence and finance data lake solutions to drive strategic performance improvements. You will manage techno-functional assessments of finance data processes, lead analysis of data challenges, and design innovative, data-driven finance solutions. Your role will involve collaborating with senior client stakeholders across industries and geographies to unlock actionable insights from finance data and enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Manager with deep expertise in finance data intelligence, finance data lakes, and finance process optimization. Candidates should have strong knowledge of corporate finance processes, ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, etc.), and finance data analytics. Experience in FP&A, Financial Accounting, and Reporting domains is highly desirable. This role offers a unique opportunity to lead and grow EY’s global finance data intelligence service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead finance function engagements covering Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and Order to Cash (O2C) processes, focusing on finance data flows, reconciliations, journals, transaction matching, variance analysis, intercompany transactions, and fixed assets accounting.
* Drive workshops and stakeholder interviews to perform comprehensive current state (As-Is) finance data process assessments and design optimized future state processes leveraging finance data lakes and advanced analytics.
* Identify and prioritize finance data process improvement opportunities through automation, data integration, technology upgrades, and finance data transformation initiatives.
* Oversee the implementation and development of finance data lakes, data pipelines, and governance frameworks.
* Design and implement KPIs, dashboards, and control frameworks for finance data monitoring and reporting across O2C, P2P, and R2R processes.
* Translate complex business requirements into technical data models and solutions, ensuring alignment with client objectives.
* Lead data profiling, data quality assessments, and validation activities using SQL, Excel, and analytics tools.
* Ensure comprehensive documentation of finance data processes, data models, and project deliverables.
* Collaborate with project managers, cross-functional teams, and senior client stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
* Apply strong accounting expertise to interpret financial reports and statements in the context of data analytics and governance.
* Provide guidance on financial consolidation, cost allocation, finance planning, and budgeting processes as they relate to data integration.
* Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end financial close activities with a focus on data accuracy and reconciliation.
* Possess in-depth technical knowledge of ERP systems (SAP ERP/HANA, Oracle GL) and finance data structures.
* Lead Chart of Accounts (CoA) design and finance data architecture initiatives.
* Manage and mentor junior consultants and analysts on finance data intelligence projects.
* Effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Proven experience in consulting or finance data intelligence leadership roles.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
* Adaptable and able to navigate ambiguity and evolving business environments.
* Collaborative team leader with a focus on driving results and fostering a positive team culture.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Knowledge on AI models and understanding of context of GENAI. ML and Agentic in Finance

**To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have**

* CA, CFA, CPA, MBA, or Master’s degree in Finance or related field.
* 5-8 years of relevant experience in finance data intelligence, finance analytics, or finance domain.
* Advanced skills in Excel, PowerPoint, and SQL.

**Ideally, You’ll Also Have**

* Hands-on experience with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle), financial consolidation tools (HFM), and finance data lake platforms.
* Experience leading finance transformation, ERP implementation, and data governance initiatives.
* Project management certification or experience.
* Strong stakeholder management and client engagement skills.

**What We Look For**

* A strategic thinker with commercial acumen, technical expertise, and a passion for continuous learning.
* A leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys working with global teams and clients across industries.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, you will lead impactful projects with some of the world’s top companies. We emphasize education, coaching, and practical experience to support your leadership and professional growth. You will have the autonomy to shape your career with an individual progression plan and take on challenging assignments in an interdisciplinary environment focused on quality and knowledge sharing. Additionally, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching, and feedback from experienced leaders and colleagues.
* Opportunities to develop new skills and advance your career.
* Flexibility to manage your role in a way that suits you.

title: AVIT Meeting Room Operations L3 Lead
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description**
**AVIT Meeting Room**
**Operations L3 Lead**
**Role Overview**
The role leads a technically skilled Level 3 operations team supporting meeting-room devices and connected peripherals. It combines hands-on technical leadership with service management, work allocation, escalation ownership, operational governance, reporting, and continuous improvement. The Lead works closely with monitoring teams, engineering, project teams, onsite support, service desk, platform teams, vendors and technology stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Operational Leadership**

* Lead daily L3 operations, balancing incidents, service requests, onboarding and offboarding activities, problem investigations, and improvement work.
* Allocate work based on priority, impact, technical complexity, regional coverage and resource availability.
* Run operational reviews and shift handovers, ensuring ownership, blockers, risks and next actions are clearly documented.
* Maintain effective support coverage and act as the primary operational escalation point for the L3 team.
* Coach team members, strengthen technical capability, and encourage consistent troubleshooting and documentation practices.

**Advanced Incident and Problem Management**

* Provide technical direction for complex meeting-room incidents that cannot be resolved by L1, L2 or monitoring teams.
* Coordinate diagnosis across endpoint, operating system, application, account, network, peripheral and room-integration dependencies.
* Own major or recurring issue progression, bringing together internal resolver groups, engineering teams and vendors as required.
* Ensure incident records include clear technical findings, actions, evidence, workarounds, resolution details and follow-up requirements.
* Drive root-cause analysis and corrective actions for repeat failures, alert noise and avoidable ticket demand.

**Service Reliability and Monitoring**

* Use operational data and monitoring insights to identify device-health risks, recurring alert patterns, estate-wide issues and service degradation.
* Partner with monitoring and engineering teams to improve alert quality, routing, thresholds and actionable diagnostics.
* Track device compliance, connectivity, application and operating-system health, and operational readiness across in-scope platforms.
* Coordinate recovery campaigns and validate that restored devices remain stable after corrective action.

**Device Lifecycle Operations**

* Oversee operational support for meeting-room device onboarding, configuration validation, readiness testing, BAU handover, replacement and offboarding.
* Confirm that prerequisite activities, dependencies, ownership and acceptance criteria are understood before L3 work begins.
* Coordinate with project managers, onsite support and dependent platform teams to resolve gaps affecting deployment or decommissioning.
* Maintain accurate operational records, handover evidence and supporting documentation for lifecycle activities.

**Stakeholder, Vendor and Escalation Management**

* Provide concise updates on service impact, current status, risks, decisions, dependencies and expected next actions.
* Facilitate technical bridges and cross-team troubleshooting for high-impact or multi-domain issues.
* Engage OEMs and support partners for advanced diagnostics, defect investigation, warranty and replacement cases.
* Ensure escalations are evidence-based, assigned to the appropriate owner and progressed until closure or formal handoff.

**Governance, Reporting and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain and improve standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, support boundaries and escalation paths.
* Review service performance, ticket ageing, recurring failure themes, backlog, restoration trends and improvement opportunities.
* Drive automation, monitoring enhancements, self-heal opportunities and ticket-elimination initiatives with measurable outcomes.
* Support operational readiness for new products, platform changes, service transitions and global deployment programmes.
* Promote compliance with change, incident, problem, asset, security and data-handling requirements.

**Technology and Service Environment**
**Area Indicative Environment**
**Meeting-room platforms :**
Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows and Android, Surface Hub, interactive displays, video-conferencing endpoints, room bars, cameras, microphones, speakers, touch panels and room-signage devices
  
  
**Operations tooling :**
ServiceNow, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, monitoring platforms such as Utelogy, Microsoft Intune, reporting dashboards and knowledge repositories
  
  
**Technical domains :**
Windows and Android endpoints, Teams Rooms applications, device accounts, identity and access, networking fundamentals, firmware, drivers, peripherals, remote management and AV signal flow
  
  
**Service practices**
: Incident, request, problem, change, knowledge, asset, vendor, warranty/RMA, onboarding, offboarding and operational reporting
  
  
**Candidate Profile**
**Required Experience And Knowledge**

* Demonstrable experience leading or coordinating advanced AV, unified communications, meeting-room or endpoint operations in an enterprise environment.
* Strong troubleshooting experience across Microsoft Teams Rooms, room peripherals, endpoint operating systems, device management and network dependencies.
* Experience managing complex incidents, technical escalations, vendors and cross-functional resolver teams.
* Practical understanding of IT service management processes, including incident, problem, change, request and knowledge management.
* Experience producing operational reports, trend analysis, executive updates, technical documentation and knowledge content.
* Ability to work effectively in a global support model and coordinate across regions, time zones and diverse stakeholder groups.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in information technology, electronics, telecommunications, AV systems or a related discipline.
* Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, vendor or service-management certification.
* Experience with ServiceNow, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Pro Management Portal, Power BI, Power Query or comparable monitoring and analytics platforms.
* Exposure to device lifecycle programmes, service transition, automation and large-scale operational recovery initiatives.

title: Teamleader
description:
**👊 We zoeken een teamleader om ons team in het tankstation langs de autosnelweg aan te sturen!**

* Ben jij iemand die niet bang is om de handen uit de mouwen te steken?
* Hou je ervan om een team aan te sturen, verantwoordelijkheid te nemen én tegelijk zelf mee te werken op de vloer?
* Heb je al enkele jaren ervaring in leidinggeven, liefst in de voedingssector?

👉 3x ja? Dan ben jij misschien onze nieuwe
**collega**
!
  
  
**💼 Wat ga je doen?**
Als Teamleader ondersteun je de manager in het dagelijkse beheer van het autostrade tankstation. Samen met je collega-teamleaders draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor de shop, de broodjeszaak én het restaurant.
  
  

* Samen met de Manager en de andere Teamleader(s) stuur je een Team aan. Je motiveert hen door te luisteren en te helpen waar nodig: je bent een echte people manager
* Je zorgt voor de netheid en goede staat van het station (shop/piste), de beschikbaarheid van producten in de rekken en een verzorgde presentatie van de broodjesbar
* Je waakt over het goede verloop van alle activiteiten en de tevredenheid van de klanten
* Je ziet toe op het naleven van procedures en geldende voedselveiligheidsnormen
* Je draait regelmatig mee in shift en verzekert de permanentie samen met de andere Teamleaders en de Manager
* Je neemt deel aan de administratieve opvolging (bestellingen, inventarissen, enz.)
* Je analyseert verkoopcijfers en stelt indien nodig actieplannen op

Kortom: jij bent een
**dynamische leider**
die niet alleen aanstuurt, maar ook zelf meewerkt 💪.
  
  
**🎓 Opleiding & ondersteuning**
Je krijgt alle opleidingen die je nodig hebt om je rol met vertrouwen uit te voeren. Je Manager staat altijd klaar om je te ondersteunen.
  
  
**🌟 Wie zoeken wij?**

* Je hebt enkele jaren ervaring in leidinggeven, bij voorkeur in een voedingsomgeving
* Je bent een echte doener en durft verantwoordelijkheid te nemen
* Je geeft het goede voorbeeld en werkt graag samen met je team op de vloer
* Je hebt verantwoordelijkheidszin, organisatietalent en een flinke dosis energie
* Je spreekt Nederlands en durft klanten ook in het Engels of Frans te helpen
* Diploma is minder belangrijk dan je inzet en doorzettingsvermogen

Iedereen is welkom, zolang je zin hebt om erin te vliegen en je schouders eronder te zetten!
  
  
**💰 Wat bieden wij?**
We waarderen je inzet en zorgen voor een correcte verloning.
  
  

* Loon volgens Paritair Comité 311: tussen € 2598.43 bruto en € 2981.38 bruto, afhankelijk van relevante ervaring
* Maaltijdcheques, bijkomende premies en woon-werkvergoeding
* GSM met abonnement zodat je ook vanop afstand je team kan ondersteunen
* Groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, individuele premie, 13e maand, extra verlofdagen
* Een groot bedrijf met goede organisatie, maar een klein teamgevoel in je station
* Uitgebreid opleidingstraject en reële doorgroeikansen 🚀
* Mogelijkheid om ervaring op te doen in andere stations voor extra dynamiek

**✨ Waarom kies je voor ons?**
Omdat we geloven dat wie zich goed voelt, gaat schitteren. Hier krijg je niet alleen een job, maar een loopbaan in een omgeving waar je écht gewaardeerd wordt 🌟.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Delivery Manager**

Client Delivery & Operations • Digital Marketing

**Purpose of the Role**

Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients. The Delivery Manager owns the system that keeps that growth running smoothly — making on-time, on-scope delivery the standard across every account by owning intake, planning, capacity, cadence, and quality end to end.

This is a dedicated operations role focused on one outcome: consistent, reliable delivery. It is the foundation that lets clients trust us with more work and lets the team do its best work without friction.

**Reporting**

**Reports to:**
COO / Managing Director

**Works with:**
Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and specialists across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.

**Core Responsibilities**
**1. Own on-time delivery across all accounts**

•  Hold end-to-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.

•  Maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.

**2. Plan capacity and resources**

•  Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over-allocation
**before**
it causes slippage.

•  Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.

•  Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.

**3. Control intake, priorities, and scope**

•  Run a disciplined intake process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.

•  Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands.

•  Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.

**4. Run the delivery cadence**

•  Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup + weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.

•  Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.

•  Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.

**5. Enforce quality**

•  Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.

•  For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).

•  Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.

**6. Report to clients and leadership**

•  Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.

•  Give leadership an honest, data-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.

**7. Build the delivery system**

•  Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.

•  Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.

•  Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.

**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)**

Delivery health is measured, reviewed monthly, and owned by this role:

**Metric Target**

1. On-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
2. Rework rate < 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
3. Client-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
4. Team utilization 75–85% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
5. SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
6. Delivery visibility 100% of active work tracked in one live source of truth
7. Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after

**Qualifications**

•  Minimum 5+ years in project or delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.

•  Proven track record improving or scaling on-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.

•  Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social, creative and video production, web development, content, and analytics — enough to judge quality and timelines, and to execute hands-on, if essential.

•  Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.

•  Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.

•  Strong on process design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.

**Ideal Candidate**

An operations leader who makes delivery boringly predictable. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, hands-on and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good quality work ship on time — every account, every time.

**CTC:**
As per market for the right fit candidate

title: Field Debt Manager
description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI,

Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**About the Team**

The Debt Management team is responsible for ensuring timely and efficient recovery of outstanding dues from customers. Their role involves designing, implementing, and optimizing collection strategies across various channels to minimize delinquencies and improve cash flow. The team focuses on balancing customer experience with recovery effectiveness by using data-driven insights, segmentation, and targeted action plans.

**What You’ll Own**

* Managing a team of ground Field Executives for effective & efficient recovery of overdue amounts from default customers through planned visits to customer addresses
* Ensure proper planning for effective recovery through strong execution; guide and motivate the field team to reach monthly targets
* Overview of day-to-day agent activities including regular performance monitoring, in-person visits for high-value accounts, and regular & timely follow-ups with customers
* Guide executives to increase contactability with customers and execute advanced loss prevention activities wherever applicable (i.e. skip tracing, foreclosures, etc.)
* Maintain fair collection practices in adherence with the code of conduct & legal guidelines and ensure that the team follows the same
* Ensure agents regularly attend all meetings, AHMs, and training sessions as required
* Highlight accounts requiring legal action and follow the process on the same
* Ensure that the team adheres to SOPs related to collection, such as timely updation of feedback for assigned accounts, conducting in-depth review and audit of collection cases, alongside reviewing and presenting a synthesis of high-value accounts on a weekly basis
* Run daily team stand-up/ huddle, ensure attendance and App adoption by the agent
* Ensure that you and the team are up to date on all relevant circulars and all products/services offered.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Strong communication and influencing skills.
* Should have a geographical understanding of the specified area.
* 2 - 5 years of people management experience in sales, operations, customer experience, or collections role.
* Should have a working knowledge of MS Excel and Google Sheets
* Should have high professional ethics and integrity
* Qualification: Any Graduate

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious, and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone, or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page: navi.com/careers/life-at-navi.

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale, and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

Navi could be the place for you!

title: Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: Specialist, Engineering Services
description:
Being the go-to MEP/CIVIL person
  
  
Are you considered to be the go-to person for all MEP/CIVIL matters? That’s what you’ll be in this role. You’ll manage all activities related to mechanical, engineering and plumbing in terms of planning, designing, procurement, construction, testing and commissioning, and final handover. Your task is to fully understand, collect and deliver clients’ MEP/CIVIL requirements. The design manager in MEP/CIVIL will depend on you to help schedule or plan establishment, value engineer, and design change management. You’ll also assist the contract manager in MEP/CIVIL-related procurement and VO management. On top of that, you’ll support the construction manager in MEP/CIVIL-related installation, site inspection and contractor management.
  
  
Making visions come true
  
  
You’ll develop big ideas that will spark the effective management and successful execution of all phases of a project—from initiating, designing, planning, controlling, executing, monitoring, and closing. You’ll need to carefully identify and take note of our clients’ needs, and figure out what exactly needs to be done. This involves defining the scope of the work and expected outcome, while also detailing all the necessary objectives to get there.
  
  
While you do all of these, you’ll need to keep tabs on company resources used in the projects, and to allocate these resources to complete the project within the budget. You’ll also need to help clients organize and analyze all tender and procurement for all contractors and suppliers; and represent them from the beginning to the end of a project.
  
  
Building strong teams and business reputation
  
  
One of your priorities will be to produce high-performing teams that drive successful project execution. You’ll also represent and promote the company throughout projects and in pursuit of more project opportunities.
  
  
Keeping risks at bay
  
  
How do you deal with risks? You’ll need to identify any potential risks in the MEP/CIVIL field and report them to the Project Manager. It will be critical to design a risk management and solution provision, particularly to identify health & safety issues. You will understand why this is your responsibility.
  
  
**Sound like you? To apply you need to be:**
An MEP/CIVIL pro
  
  
You have a degree in MEP/CIVIL engineering-related discipline or related field, and five years of combined educational and work experience. You also need to have sufficient experience in construction site management, as well as a strong understanding of all aspects of development management including, financial appraisal, risk management, negotiation, etc.
  
  
Do you have a strong background of all aspects of MEP/CIVIL-related management—including the development of MEP/CIVIL project plan and procedures and construction schedules? Are you familiar with HVAC, electrical engineering, and BMS? Do you have knowledge of security system, AV system, and IT system? If your answers are yes, let’s talk.
  
  
A business savvy leader who can walk the talk
  
  
You understand the business well enough, particularly in terms of the systems and tools to use, the best practices and the safety requirements. You’re also knowledgeable of key industries and local market, with the real estate and construction business above all. You also have a basic understanding of the key drivers that push the projects forward, while also considering the client’s business requirements.
  
  
You’ll back up your business know-hows with the necessary communication skills, as you need to regularly do business development presentations to potential clients in both English and Chinese. You’ll also manage site activities, negotiate with contractors, review the legal aspects of contracts, contribute to market analysis, and manage change orders.
  
  
A flexible leader with superb interpersonal skills
  
  
Are you a people person with superb interpersonal skills? You’ll need to create a proactive working environment that not only motivates your employees, but also encourages them to maintain good relationship with clients, communicate effectively with each other, and contribute enthusiastically to the project. You also need to be a results-oriented leader with good problem-solving skills, as well as someone who can nurture positive relationships with all stakeholders involved, including your team members and clients.
  
  
**What we can do for you:**
At JLL, we make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits package.
  
  
Apply today!

At FedTec Reply, we are hiring an Innovation Lab leader to join our team. In this role you will be working on building innovative enablers and accelerators for our federal clients. * Define and lead the vision, roadmap, and delivery standards for FedTec's SaaS and AI-native innovation center, spanning AI transformation, service management, and cybersecurity offerings.

* Experience with hyperscaler cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and modern DevSecOps practices.

title: Senior Audit Associate
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION – AUDIT MANAGER
  
  
Organisation: DPSM & Co., Chartered Accountants
  
Position: Audit Manager
  
Function: Audit, Assurance & Taxation
  
Location: Kochi
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
DPSM & Co. is looking for an experienced Audit Manager capable of independently managing audit and assurance assignments while leading a team of approximately 5–7members.
  
  
CA articleship completed candidates will be given high priority
  
  
The position requires a strong combination of technical knowledge, team leadership, client management and execution discipline. The Audit Manager will be responsible for planning, supervising and completing assignments within committed timelines while maintaining the firm's quality and documentation standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Audit & Assurance
  
  
- Plan, execute, supervise and review Statutory Audits, Tax Audits and other assurance assignments.
  
- Handle assignments involving:
  
- Public Limited Companies
  
- Private Limited Companies
  
- LLPs
  
- Partnership Firms
  
- Other business entities
  
- Ensure compliance with applicable Standards on Auditing (SAs), Companies Act, Income-tax Act and other regulatory requirements.
  
- Review audit working papers, financial statements, disclosures and audit documentation before Partner review.
  
- Identify significant audit observations, control weaknesses and compliance risks and communicate them appropriately to clients and Partners.
  
  
2. Team Management & Resource Planning
  
  
- Lead and supervise an audit team of approximately 15–20 members, including qualified/semi-qualified professionals, audit assistants and article trainees.
  
- Allocate assignments based on team capability, experience, deadlines and workload.
  
- Prepare and monitor audit schedules, resource deployment and assignment-wise timelines.
  
- Conduct regular reviews of work performed by team members and ensure timely closure of review points.
  
- Guide and train team members on audit procedures, taxation, documentation and professional standards.
  
- Ensure effective utilisation of team resources across multiple simultaneous assignments.
  
  
3. Direct & Indirect Taxation
  
  
The candidate should possess sound practical knowledge of:
  
  
- Income Tax – Tax Audit, TDS/TCS, return filing, assessments and related compliance.
  
- GST – Returns, reconciliations, ITC, notices, assessments and other GST compliance matters.
  
- Relevant provisions of the Companies Act, LLP Act and allied laws affecting audit and financial reporting.
  
- Ability to identify taxation and regulatory issues arising during audit assignments and coordinate their resolution.
  
  
4. Client & Regulatory Communication
  
  
- Act as a key point of contact between clients, audit teams and Partners.
  
- Conduct audit planning and closure discussions with client management.
  
- Communicate audit requirements, observations and pending matters professionally and clearly.
  
- Coordinate and communicate, wherever required, with Income Tax, GST and other regulatory authorities.
  
- Maintain strong professional relationships with clients while ensuring independence and audit quality.
  
  
5. Timeline & Pressure Management
  
  
- Manage multiple audit and compliance assignments simultaneously.
  
- Work effectively during statutory filing periods, audit seasons and other deadline-driven situations.
  
- Anticipate potential delays and take corrective action through appropriate resource planning.
  
- Escalate critical issues to Partners on a timely basis rather than allowing assignments to exceed committed timelines.
  
- Ensure timely completion without compromising audit quality or documentation.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  
Experience: Preferably 2–3+ years of relevant experience in a Chartered Accountant firm / audit environment, including meaningful experience in independently handling teams and assignments.
  
  
Qualification: CA Inter / other suitably qualified candidates with strong and demonstrable audit experience may be considered depending upon the level of experience.CA Articleship completed articles will be given high priority.
  
  
Essential Competencies
  
  
- Proven experience in team handling and leadership.
  
- Strong practical exposure to audits of companies, LLPs and partnership firms.
  
- Sound knowledge of Direct Tax and GST.
  
- Strong understanding of audit procedures and documentation.
  
- Excellent client communication and interpersonal skills.
  
- Ability to communicate professionally with tax and regulatory authorities.
  
- Strong resource planning, delegation and review capabilities.
  
- Ability to prioritise assignments and perform effectively under timeline pressure.
  
- High level of ownership, accountability and problem-solving ability.
  
- Working knowledge of Excel, accounting software and audit/documentation tools.
  
  
What We Expect From the Role
  
  
The Audit Manager is expected to function as the operational link between the Partners and the audit team. The person should be capable of taking ownership of an assignment from planning to closure, ensuring that the Partner's involvement is focused primarily on critical professional judgement, significant audit matters and final review.
  
  
The role therefore requires someone who can lead people, manage clients, understand technical issues, control timelines and take responsibility for delivery rather than merely execute individual audit tasks.
  
  
DPSM & Co., Chartered Accountants
  
Audit | Assurance | Taxation | Advisory
