title: Assistant Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: General Manager, BibleOn
description:
General Manager, BibleOn

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala

**Employment:**
Full-time, on-site

**Reporting to:**
Thomson Philip, Co-founder of BibleOn and CEO of Eloit Innovations

**About BibleOn**

BibleOn is a free, ad-free Bible app with a mission to bring the Word of God to people in their own language. Rooted in the Catholic faith and welcoming everyone, BibleOn offers text and audio Scriptures in international, regional and tribal languages, helping individuals and families build a deeper relationship with Jesus through His Word.

Our vision extends beyond an app. We are building a global community of readers, listeners, volunteers, supporters and digital missionaries who help others discover and engage with the Holy Scriptures.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an exceptional, mission-driven leader to take full responsibility for leading BibleOn into its next stage of growth.

The General Manager, BibleOn will assume day-to-day leadership from the Co-founder and lead the initiative with independence, sound judgement and accountability. Working within the vision, strategic direction and agreed budgets set with the Co-founder, you will translate that vision into clear priorities, build the right team and deliver measurable results.

This role combines ministry leadership with the discipline of running a growing digital platform. You will lead operations, product priorities, language expansion, content, audience growth, Church partnerships, fundraising and campaigns, working with the existing team and recruiting additional talent as required.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership, make decisions and move the mission forward with limited day-to-day supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead the Mission and Strategy**

* Translate BibleOn’s vision into an actionable growth plan with clear milestones, budgets and measures of success.
* Take ownership of execution across the entire initiative, resolving challenges and keeping priorities focused.
* Work closely with the Co-founder on strategic direction, major partnerships and decisions requiring his guidance.
* Provide concise, regular updates on progress, finances, opportunities and matters requiring leadership attention.

**2. Lead Operations and Build the Team**

* Assume responsibility for daily operations and coordinate the existing team across technology, content, languages, outreach and user support.
* Recruit, develop and lead employees, volunteers, language coordinators and external collaborators.
* Establish clear responsibilities, practical workflows and a culture of service, accountability and follow-through.
* Manage budgets, resources and delivery schedules to support sustainable growth.

**3. Expand Languages and Content**

* Develop and execute a plan to expand BibleOn’s text and audio Bible offerings, particularly for underserved language communities.
* Build relationships with Bible publishers, rights holders, translators, recording partners and Church organisations.
* Oversee permissions, content sourcing, production, quality review and publication.
* Develop Scripture-centred content and initiatives that encourage regular Bible reading, listening and spiritual growth.
* Maintain fidelity to Catholic teaching in BibleOn’s original faith content, supported by appropriate theological review.

**4. Grow the Audience and Community**

* Lead user acquisition, engagement and retention across countries and language communities.
* Plan and deliver digital campaigns, parish outreach, community programmes and partnerships.
* Build a network of digital missionaries, volunteers and ambassadors who introduce BibleOn to others.
* Use audience insights and performance data to improve campaigns, content and the user experience.

**5. Build Global Church Relationships**

* Develop active partnerships with dioceses, parishes, religious congregations, Catholic institutions, ministries and lay movements.
* Draw on an established global Catholic network to create opportunities for distribution, language expansion, collaboration and support.
* Represent BibleOn professionally at Church gatherings, conferences and partner meetings.
* Build lasting relationships grounded in trust, service and a shared commitment to spreading the Word of God.

**6. Lead Fundraising and Campaigns**

* Develop and execute a fundraising strategy that supports BibleOn’s free, ad-free mission.

title: Project Lead - Civil
description:

**Job Summary**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to handle Project Management activities independently, including managing a team, from project kickoff through successful delivery.

title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
description:

The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. * Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end-to-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.
* Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred.
* Experience supporting global or multi-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Industry 4.0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous.
* Experience within engineer-to-order, project-based, high-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

**About Us**
Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.

Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.

We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.

title: Senior Manager (HoD)
description:
MetAntz is recruitment marketplace, connecting top talents with high paying global opportunities. Our vision is to enable single click hiring. Top talents register on our platform, take automated AI video assessment and will get automatically matched with suitable opportunities. We help companies hire the top talents best suited for their job roles, as employee or as contractor, in budget and quickly. We can also support with Employer of Record or Contractor of Record services whenever needed.
  
  
**Senior Manager (HoD)**
**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala, India
  
  
**Department:**
Research & Development
  
  
**Industry:**
Robotics, Underwater Systems & Deep-Tech Engineering
  
  
**Experience:**
10+ Years
  
  
**Role Type:**
Senior Leadership
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for an experienced
**Sr Manager of R&D**
to lead the end-to-end technology and product development function for a deep-tech engineering organization specializing in underwater robotics and integrated hardware-software systems.
  
  
The role will be responsible for translating business and customer requirements into reliable, scalable, and production-ready products. The ideal candidate will bring strong systems-engineering expertise, product development experience, and proven leadership capabilities to build a high-performing R&D organization.
  
  
The position requires a combination of technical judgment, strategic thinking, execution discipline, and cross-functional leadership to drive product innovation and business growth.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* R&D Strategy & Technology Roadmap
* Define and execute a 2–3-year R&D and technology roadmap aligned with business objectives and customer requirements.
* Identify emerging technologies, innovation opportunities, and platform development priorities.
* Establish technology-readiness milestones and product development priorities.
* Product Development & Engineering Delivery
* Lead the complete product development lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through prototyping, integration, validation, field trials, and production handover.
* Ensure engineering programs meet agreed timelines, budgets, quality standards, and performance objectives.
* Drive structured program governance, milestone tracking, risk management, and corrective actions.
* Systems Engineering & Technical Excellence
* Oversee multidisciplinary engineering across mechanical systems, electronics, embedded systems, software, controls, sensors, communications, and system integration.
* Establish strong engineering practices covering requirements management, design reviews, configuration control, and verification and validation.
* Drive structured problem-solving, reliability engineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
* Testing, Validation & Product Reliability
* Establish validation strategies covering laboratory testing, environmental testing, integration, endurance, and field trials.
* Ensure products meet defined reliability, performance, safety, and acceptance criteria before release.
* Monitor field failures and recurring defects and drive corrective and preventive actions.
* Production Readiness & Industrialization
* Ensure smooth transition of products from R&D to manufacturing and operations.
* Establish complete handover processes covering engineering drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), specifications, firmware, software versions, test procedures, and acceptance criteria.
* Improve design-for-manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, and production readiness.
* Customer & Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with business leadership, Sales, Operations, Production, and project teams to evaluate technical feasibility and customer requirements.
* Support technical discussions, solution estimation, field trials, and customer escalations.
* Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, risks are identified early, and dependencies are resolved effectively.
* Team Leadership & Organization Development
* Lead and develop multidisciplinary R&D teams and engineering leaders.
* Establish clear responsibilities, accountability, performance expectations, and succession plans.
* Identify capability gaps and develop hiring and team-strengthening strategies.
* Build a culture of technical excellence, transparency, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Budget, Partnerships & Risk Management
* Own R&D budgeting, resource planning, laboratory infrastructure, prototyping, tools, and external development requirements.
* Evaluate technology vendors, development partners, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Protect intellectual property, technical documentation, source code, and confidential engineering knowledge.
* Manage technical, supply-chain, component obsolescence, compliance, and program risks.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
**Performance Will Be Measured Against The Following Areas**

* Program Delivery: Milestone adherence, schedule variance, and delivery against committed plans.
* Product Quality & Reliability: Validation pass rates, field failures, defect recurrence, and endurance performance.
* Engineering Excellence: Design-review compliance, documentation quality, requirements traceability, and engineering-change closure.
* Production Readiness: Handover completeness, production rework, and manufacturing-related engineering issues.
* Innovation & Technology Roadmap: Roadmap achievement, technology maturity, platform reuse, and meaningful IP development.
* Customer Responsiveness: Technical issue resolution, trial readiness, and estimation accuracy.
* People Leadership: Retention of key talent, leadership development, succession planning, and team effectiveness.
* Cost & Resource Management: Budget adherence, resource utilization, prototyping costs, and development efficiency.
* Risk Management: Early identification, mitigation, and closure of critical technical and program risks.

**Candidate Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related engineering discipline.
* A postgraduate qualification in engineering, technology management, or business is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 15+ years of progressive experience in engineering, R&D, or complex product development.
* At least 5 years in a senior R&D or engineering leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams and complex technology programs.
* Proven experience taking integrated hardware-software products from concept and prototyping through validation, industrialization, and field deployment.
* Experience in robotics, autonomous systems, marine technology, defence, aerospace, industrial electronics, embedded systems, or similar deep-tech environments is strongly preferred.
* Exposure to high-reliability, mission-critical, government, or defence customer requirements is an advantage.

**Technical & Functional Skills**

* Strong understanding of systems engineering and multidisciplinary product architecture.
* Expertise in new product development (NPD), stage-gate processes, requirements management, and verification and validation.
* Experience in engineering program management, estimation, resource planning, and risk mitigation.
* Familiarity with design reviews, configuration management, engineering change control, and technical documentation.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, FMEA, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving techniques.
* Understanding of design for manufacturing, assembly, serviceability, and production handover.
* Experience in technology evaluation, vendor management, and make-versus-buy decisions.
* Awareness of IP protection, product compliance, cybersecurity considerations, and component lifecycle management.
* Ability to translate customer requirements into feasible technical solutions and credible delivery commitments.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Strategic Thinking: Develops long-term technology and product strategies aligned with business priorities.
* Execution Excellence: Converts complex objectives into clear milestones, ownership, and measurable outcomes.
* Technical Judgment: Makes sound engineering decisions across multiple disciplines and evaluates trade-offs effectively.
* People Leadership: Develops future leaders, sets clear standards, and builds a culture of accountability.
* Stakeholder Management: Resolves cross-functional conflicts and aligns engineering, commercial, and operational priorities.
* Communication: Explains complex technical matters clearly to leadership, customers, and engineering teams.
* Decision-Making: Makes timely, evidence-based decisions and adapts when new information becomes available.
* Innovation & Learning: Encourages experimentation while maintaining engineering rigor and product quality.
* Integrity & Transparency: Communicates risks and delays early and maintains credibility around commitments.
* Composure Under Pressure: Provides direction during customer escalations, failed trials, and competing delivery priorities.

**First 180-Day Expectations**

* Assess the existing R&D organization, active programs, technical debt, capability gaps, and delivery risks.
* Establish a consolidated R&D portfolio with clear priorities, ownership, milestones, and escalation mechanisms.
* Strengthen product development processes, design reviews, documentation, configuration control, validation, and production handover.
* Develop an agreed technology roadmap and capacity plan in alignment with senior leadership, Sales, and Operations.
* Review the organization structure, leadership responsibilities, succession priorities, and critical hiring requirements.
* Identify recurring field and production issues and implement measurable corrective actions.
* Establish a predictable weekly and monthly R&D governance and reporting cadence.
* Improve engineering ownership, cross-functional collaboration, delivery predictability, and closure discipline.

**Definition of Success**
Success in this role means building a technically strong and operationally dependable R&D organization with a clear technology roadmap, reliable product releases, disciplined engineering processes, effective production handovers, and strong cross-functional collaboration.
  
  
The Head of R&D will be expected to develop engineering leaders, institutionalize technical knowledge, improve product reliability, and position R&D as a scalable driver of innovation and business growth.
  
  
**Role Expectations**
This is a strategic and execution-oriented engineering leadership position. It is not limited to research, individual technical contribution, or project coordination.
  
  
The successful candidate must be comfortable owning business outcomes, making cross-functional decisions, balancing immediate delivery requirements with long-term product maturity, and building an R&D function that can scale with the organization.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**AI Business Solutions –AI Engineer Senior Manager:**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior Manager – AI Engineer to lead strategic AI initiatives and drive the design, development, and adoption of agent-based solutions using Microsoft AI technologies. This role combines deep technical expertise with leadership to scale AI-driven transformation across enterprise functions..
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the strategy, design, and delivery of AI-powered solutions using Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and agent-based frameworks.
* Drive enterprise-wide adoption of intelligent agents built using Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Define architecture standards, best practices, and reusable frameworks for scalable AI solutions.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify AI use cases and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Mentor team members and ensure high-quality delivery across AI initiatives.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong expertise in Copilot Studio and enterprise-grade AI agent development.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel (Python or C#).
* Extensive experience with Azure AI Foundry and AI/ML ecosystem.
* Deep understanding of agent-based architectures, orchestration patterns, and enterprise integrations.
* Proven ability to define architecture and lead large-scale AI programs.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and strategic thinking skills.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI solutions within enterprise systems and workflows.
* Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and reusable components.
* Ensure solution performance, reliability, and alignment with enterprise security and governance standards.
* Ability to work effectively in distributed, onshore–offshore delivery models.

**Ideally, you’ll also**
The following skills are preferred and add value to the role:
  
  

* Experience with Power Platform.
* Experience with Azure Integration Services.
* Experience supporting large transformation or digital modernization programs
* Familiarity with testing tools, deployment cycles, and release management practices
* Experience working across multiple industries or complex business environments

**What We Look For**

* Total Experience: [12+ Years]
* Relevant Experience (AI/Agent-based solutions): 1+ Years
* Prior experience in client-facing consulting or enterprise delivery engagements.
* Degree in BE / B.Tech / MCA / MBA or equivalent with relevant industry experience.
* Microsoft AI certification is preferred.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**
We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead our R&D Engineering team, drive new product development and continuous improvement, and deliver innovative, cost-effective engineering solutions that meet customer needs and strengthen NOV’s technological advantage. Responsible for directing and coordinating the Engineering team to maintain and improve existing products while addressing the customers’ needs and maintaining NOVs technological advantage in the industry. Ensuring that this is achieved in a cost effective and efficient manner.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Deliver engineering projects on time, on budget, and to quality expectations.
* Improve product reliability and reduce customer issues through sustaining engineering.
* Develop and retain a high-performing engineering team through coaching and succession planning.
* Drive cost reduction and continuous improvement initiatives that improve profitability.
* Partner with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure engineering solutions meet business and market needs.
* Direct department activities to design new products, modify existing designs, and improve production techniques.
* Utilize standard engineering calculations related to specific design or analytical projects.
* Manage and coordinate team activities including training, employee development, performance evaluation, hiring decisions, establishment of goals, and performance objectives.
* Manage budget and expenditures.
* Direct and see project through to completion with assistance of technical personnel.
* Develop accurate and complete documentation of data and project results in a timely manner.
* Interact with personnel in other departments and disciplines.
* Participate in action plans for new projects defined by supervisor.
* Consistently produce quality work and recommend areas where quality can be improved.
* Assist with generation and delivery of customer presentations.
* Attend field runs and visit service shops to provide basic technical support for products as needed.
* Partner with Manufacturing to improve manufacturability, reduce costs, and optimize product performance.

**Qualifications**

* A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical engineering or similar
* 12-15 years’ experience in Research and Development engineering role.
* Product Specific Design Training - Able to use design concepts, manufacturing knowledge and repair knowledge to trouble shoot product function issues.
* CAD - Create/manipulate complex models/parts/assemblies.
* FEA - Understand the theory behind FEA and be able to interpret results.
* CFD - Understand the theory behind CFD and be able to interpret results.
* IP Series Training – Understand how to do a patent search.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical personnel
* Ability to plan, organize and coordinate workflow
* Skills in verbal communications, problem solving and record keeping
* Valid B1 United States Visa is desired

**About Us**
Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
  
  
**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
  
  
**Global Family**
We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
  
  
**Purposeful Innovation**
Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
  
  
**Service Above All**
This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

title: Area Manager - Cardiac Surgery
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
This Area Manager role is responsible for commercial growth and customer engagement across Kerala and Mangalore. The position follows a remote work style with frequent field-based customer interaction and approximately 50% travel across assigned accounts, hospitals, and healthcare institutions within the territory.
  
  
The Area Manager is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding market presence, and supporting clinical adoption of Cardiac Surgery products across the assigned territory. This role works closely with cardiac surgeons, perfusion teams, hospital stakeholders, and procurement functions to deliver product education, procedural support, and account development strategies that contribute to business growth and customer success.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

* Drive territory sales growth by executing account plans and identifying opportunities to expand adoption of Cardiac Surgery therapies across assigned hospitals and healthcare institutions.
* Build and maintain clinical and commercial relationships with cardiac surgeons, perfusionists, operating room staff, vascular specialists, and procurement stakeholders.
* Provide product education, technical support, and clinical expertise to support safe and effective use of Cardiac Surgery technologies.
* Deliver procedural support during surgical cases, including troubleshooting and follow-up activities to ensure customer satisfaction and therapy adoption.
* Conduct product training and in-service programmes for new and existing customers on assigned therapy portfolios.
* Partner with key implant center's to develop strategies that increase product utilisation and support progression toward technical self-sufficiency.
* Gather and communicate market intelligence, customer feedback, competitive activity, and product performance insights to internal stakeholders.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, inventory-related activities, and territory data within approved business systems.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) AND 8+ years experience
* OR Associate’s Degree AND 6+ years experience
* OR Bachelor’s Degree AND 4+ years experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in Cardiac Surgery, Cardiovascular, Structural Heart, Perfusion, Extracorporeal Life Support, or related medical device therapies.
* Degree or certification in Perfusion Technology.
* Master's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or Master of Business Administration.
* Experience supporting live surgical procedures and working directly with cardiac surgeons and operating room teams.
* Knowledge of hospital purchasing processes, account development strategies, and healthcare market dynamics within South India.

**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**
The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers.
  
  
**Physical Job Requirements**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

title: Clinical Operations Manager
company: Jeeva Health (A unit of Hometown Homecare Pvt. Ltd)
description:
**Clinical Operations Manager (Home Care Operations)**

Organisation: Jeeva Health

Reports to: Director / Operations Head

Location: Kochi, Kerala

Work Hours - (9.30 Am - 6.30 Pm)

**Role summary**

We are looking for an experienced Clinical Operations-manager to lead our home visit nursing team and run day-to-day office coordination. You will ensure patients get safe, consistent, high-quality care at home, and that the office runs on clear processes and software.

**Key responsibilities**

* Manage the home visit nursing team: scheduling, assigning nurses to patients, supervising, and appraising performance.
* Ensure clinical quality: review care plans, visit notes, and incident reports, and handle patient or family escalations.
* Create and maintain SOPs for home visits, infection control, medication handling, emergency response, documentation, onboarding, and patient intake and discharge.
* Coordinate the whole office: patient enquiries, admissions, billing coordination, nurse attendance, and communication between doctors, families, and staff.
* Use and manage software: run the scheduling, patient record, and reporting systems, and suggest improvements or new tools.
* Train and mentor nurses and support staff and keep them current on protocols.
* Track KPIs such as visit completion rate, punctuality, patient satisfaction, and incidents, and report them to management.
* Do home visits personally when needed, for complex cases, quality checks, or staff shortages.

**Requirements**

GNM / B.Sc. Nursing /ANM with valid Kerala Nursing Council registration

3+ years of nursing experience, including managing home visit nurses

We are seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion Program / Project Manager at Manager level with proven, hands-on experience leading end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation projects across ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, or related workstreams. The ideal candidate will be well versed in Oracle Unified Method (OUM), Application Implementation Methodology (AIM), Testing and Change Management (TCM), Agile and hybrid delivery models, and the complete project lifecycle. The role requires strong ownership of program governance, integrated planning, financial and resource management, RAID and dependency management, executive status reporting, and client discussions from mobilization through go-live and Hypercare.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities and Accountabilities:**

* Lead end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation programs from mobilisation, discovery, design, configuration, build, testing, deployment, go-live, Hypercare, and transition to support.
* Create and manage integrated program plans covering scope, milestones, workstreams, critical paths, dependencies, resources, budgets, environments, deliverables, and release schedules.

* Establish program governance, decision rights, escalation paths, stage gates, quality controls, meeting cadence, and reporting standards across functional and technical workstreams.
* Own RAID management by identifying, assessing, assigning, tracking, mitigating, escalating, and closing risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies with clear owners and due dates.

**Job Requirements:**

* Minimum 10 years of overall experience, including at least 5 years in project or program management and proven hands-on leadership of multiple end-to-end Oracle Fusion Cloud implementations.
* Strong delivery experience across one or more Oracle Fusion domains such as ERP, SCM, HCM, EPM, Procurement, Projects, or cross-pillar transformation programs.
* Thorough knowledge of OUM, AIM, TCM, Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and hybrid project lifecycles.
* Demonstrated experience establishing governance, PMO controls, steering committees, stage gates, design authority, change control, delivery cadence, and quality assurance.
* Strong command of scope, schedule, budget, effort, forecasting, resource capacity, dependency, critical-path, milestone, and benefits tracking.
* Hands-on expertise in RAID logs, issue resolution, risk mitigation, decision logs, assumptions, actions, change requests, recovery plans, and executive escalation management.
* Experience managing requirements, design, Conference Room Pilots, configuration, integrations, data migration, testing, defect management, security, training, cutover, go-live, Hypercare, and support transition.
* Mandatory real hands-on expertise in Microsoft Project and MPP files, including creating and managing detailed schedules, baselines, dependencies, critical paths, milestones, resources, actuals, remaining work, slippage, variance, and forecasts.
* Ability to generate schedule, milestone, resource, cost, and executive status reports directly from MPP and explain schedule health, delays, impacts, and recovery actions to senior stakeholders.
* Strong client-facing experience, including leading difficult discussions, negotiating priorities, managing expectations, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving decisions and closure.
* Experience managing distributed teams, system integrators, vendors, subcontractors, and business stakeholders across locations and time zones.
* PMP, PRINCE2, PgMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project/program management certification is preferred.

**Competencies / Skills:**

* Strong leadership, ownership, commercial awareness, and delivery discipline, with the ability to maintain control in complex and high-pressure programs.
* Excellent client communication, facilitation, negotiation, conflict resolution, presentation, and executive stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to translate strategic objectives into executable plans, measurable milestones, clear accountability, and outcome-focused governance.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability, with sound judgement in prioritisation, decisions, risk response, and program recovery.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams while maintaining quality, schedule, budget, compliance, and stakeholder confidence.
* Must have a valid passport.
* Willing to work in MENA shift timings, Sunday to Thursday.
* Willing to work at client sites and undertake business travel as required.

* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

We’re looking for individuals who are qualified accountants with excellent leadership skills.
  
  
The incumbent gets an excellent opportunity to work virtually or directly with the engagement teams across Americas and Europe, and develop knowledge of international accounting and assurance principles
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support a portfolio of engagements, by leading a team of Assistant Managers, Seniors and Associates
* Ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY methodology and in line with the engagement team’s expectations
* Demonstrate strong understanding of EY methodology in service delivery and supporting various quality projects, such as pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, efficiency projects and others.

title: ADN-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior Associate**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
* Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
* Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
* Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
* 0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead Salesforce
description:
**Company Overview**
Milestone Technologies is a global IT managed services firm that partners with organizations to scale their technology, infrastructure and services to drive specific business outcomes such as digital transformation, innovation, and operational agility. Milestone is focused on building an employee-first, performance-based culture and for over 25 years, we have a demonstrated history of supporting category-defining enterprise clients that are growing ahead of the market. The company specializes in providing solutions across Application Services and Consulting, Digital Product Engineering, Digital Workplace Services, Private Cloud Services, AI/Automation, and ServiceNow. Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
**About the Role**
We are seeking an experienced and highly capable
**Salesforce Lead**
to drive the technical delivery of our next-generation
**Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform**
powered by Salesforce, Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, and MuleSoft.
  
  
This is a hands-on technical leadership role for professionals who can
**lead development teams, guide solution design, mentor developers and senior developers, and closely partner with architects to deliver scalable enterprise solutions**
. The ideal candidate combines deep Salesforce platform expertise with strong people leadership, delivery ownership, and architectural thinking.
  
  
As a Salesforce Lead, you will be responsible for translating business and platform strategy into high-quality technical solutions while ensuring adherence to architecture, governance, security, and engineering best practices. You will lead cross-functional teams building intelligent service management experiences across Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Agentforce, Enterprise Service Management (ESM), ITSM, CMDB, IT Asset Management, and enterprise integrations.
  
  
This role offers an opportunity to play a key leadership position in shaping the future of AI-powered service management and conversational enterprise platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership & Delivery**

* Lead a team of Salesforce Developers and Senior Salesforce Developers across multiple workstreams.
* Provide technical leadership throughout the full software development lifecycle, from solution design to production deployment.
* Partner closely with Salesforce Architects to translate architectural vision into scalable and maintainable technical solutions.
* Own technical delivery, ensuring solutions meet business, security, scalability, and performance requirements.
* Drive estimation, sprint planning, technical task allocation, and delivery execution.
* Conduct design reviews, code reviews, and architecture compliance reviews.
* Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards, coding conventions, CI/CD processes, and governance frameworks.

**Solution Design & Development**

* Lead the design and development of Salesforce solutions supporting the organization's Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Design scalable solutions leveraging Salesforce Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Sales Cloud, Platform, and Agentforce capabilities.
* Build intelligent service experiences utilizing Agentforce, AI-driven workflows, conversational experiences, and autonomous service capabilities.
* Design and develop complex solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Flows, Platform Events, Integration Patterns, and Salesforce APIs.
* Guide implementation of enterprise service management processes including:

+ Incident Management
+ Service Request Management
+ Change Management
+ Problem Management
+ Knowledge Management
+ Employee Support Services
+ CMDB Management
+ IT Asset Management
+ Service Catalog Management

**Integration & Enterprise Architecture**

* Lead enterprise integration initiatives using MuleSoft and API-led connectivity patterns.
* Design reusable integration frameworks connecting Salesforce with ITSM, ERP, HR, Monitoring, Collaboration, Identity, and Business Systems.
* Collaborate with enterprise architects and integration teams to ensure platform interoperability and data consistency.
* Drive API governance, performance optimization, security controls, and integration best practices.

**Team Leadership & Mentoring**

* Mentor Salesforce Developers and Senior Developers through coaching, design guidance, and hands-on technical support.
* Support career development and capability building within the Salesforce team.
* Identify skill gaps and define technical learning and certification roadmaps.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex solution and production challenges.

**AI & Platform Innovation**

* Champion adoption of Agentforce, Generative AI, Data Cloud, and emerging Salesforce innovations.
* Guide implementation of conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation, and self-service experiences.
* Evaluate new platform capabilities and recommend innovative solutions that improve service delivery and operational efficiency.
* Contribute to strategic platform roadmaps and technology decision-making.

**Required Qualifications**
**Must Have**

* 7 to 10 years of Salesforce platform experience with at least 2-3 years in a technical lead role.
* Strong hands-on expertise across:

+ Service Cloud
+ Sales Cloud
+ Experience Cloud
+ Salesforce Platform

* Deep technical expertise in:

+ Apex
+ Lightning Web Components (LWC)
+ Salesforce Flows
+ SOQL/SOSL
+ Platform Events
+ Integration Patterns
+ REST/SOAP APIs
+ Salesforce Security Model

* Strong experience with large-scale Salesforce implementations and enterprise delivery programs.
* Experience leading and mentoring development teams.
* Experience working alongside solution architects and enterprise architects.
* Proven ability to drive technical decision-making and delivery governance.
* Strong understanding of:

+ Data Architecture
+ Security & Sharing Models
+ DevOps & CI/CD
+ Release Management
+ Application Lifecycle Management

* Experience in Agile, Scrum, and DevOps-driven environments.
* Strong stakeholder communication and leadership skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing Enterprise Service Management (ESM) and IT Service Management (ITSM) solutions.
* Experience with:

+ CMDB
+ IT Asset Management (ITAM)
+ Service Catalog
+ Enterprise Operations Management

* Hands-on experience with MuleSoft and API Management.
* Experience working in global delivery models.
* Salesforce Platform Developer I & II Certifications.
* Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect Certification.
* Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certifications.

**Added Advantage**

* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce.
* Experience building Conversational AI and autonomous service experiences.
* Exposure to Generative AI, Prompt Engineering, Agentic AI, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts.
* Experience with Salesforce Data Cloud.
* Experience delivering Digital Transformation and Enterprise Automation initiatives.
* Knowledge of Service Operations, ITIL, or Enterprise Service Management frameworks.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are seeking professionals who:
  
  

* Think like technical leaders while remaining hands-on contributors.
* Can successfully lead teams while maintaining a strong engineering mindset.
* Are comfortable partnering with architects and influencing platform strategy.
* Enjoy solving complex enterprise-scale technology challenges.
* Can balance delivery excellence, innovation, governance, and stakeholder expectations.
* Are passionate about Agentforce, AI, Conversational Platforms, and Intelligent Automation.
* Demonstrate ownership, accountability, and strong decision-making capabilities.
* Thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments.

**Why Join Us?**

* Lead the technical delivery of a strategic Salesforce-powered Conversational Agentic ITSM Platform.
* Work with cutting-edge technologies including Agentforce, AI, Data Cloud, MuleSoft, and Enterprise Automation.
* Influence platform architecture and engineering direction.
* Lead and mentor a high-performing Salesforce engineering team.
* Collaborate with architects, integration specialists, AI engineers, and business leaders.
* Accelerate your career toward Solution Architect and Engineering Leadership pathways.
* Be part of a rapidly growing organization where innovation and impact are valued.

**Join Us ?**
If you are a seasoned Salesforce professional with a passion for technical leadership, team mentoring, enterprise-scale solution delivery, and AI-driven innovation, we invite you to join us in building the future of
**Conversational Agentic ITSM on Salesforce**
. This role offers the opportunity to combine
**technical excellence, people leadership, and architectural influence**
while shaping a transformative platform that redefines enterprise service management.
  
  
**Compensation**
Estimated Pay Range:
  
  
Exact compensation and offers of employment are dependent on circumstances of each case and will be determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, licenses or certifications, and location.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
VOYE HOMES is one of India’s leading holiday home networks, managing over 100 boutique resorts and holiday homes across 20+ destinations in India and the UAE, with more than 600 rooms and 500,000+ guests hosted.

Ranked among the Top 10 Tourism Startups in India and Top 5 Holiday Home Chains, VOYE HOMES is rapidly expanding with an estimated startup valuation of over ₹100 crore.

·      Build and implement SOPs, processes and best practices for Revenue and OTA operations.

·      Continuously identify new opportunities to increase revenue and improve commercial performance.

title: Operations and Control Tower Lead
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an execution\-focused Operations \& Control Tower Lead to manage the operational engine behind our residential rooftop solar deployments.
 



  





 In this role, you will lead the central control desk that bridges sales, engineering, local utilities, banks, and the customer. You will be directly responsible for eliminating project bottlenecks—ensuring that every residential project clears financing, approvals, procurement, dispatch, and final grid synchronization without delays or paperwork friction.
 



  





 You will also manage a dedicated customer success and coordination team, ensuring homeowners experience proactive, transparent communication from the moment a contract is signed to final commissioning.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Central Order\-to\-Delivery Ownership** 
 : Run the central operations desk tracking residential projects from contract signing through to final commissioning and handoff.
* **Customer Success Desk Management** 
 : Lead and coach a team of customer coordinators/relationship executives. Set clear service\-level agreements (SLAs), communication cadences, and escalation protocols so customers are continuously updated via WhatsApp, calls, and email.
* **Financing \& Banking Coordination** 
 : Work directly with partner banks and NBFCs to track customer solar loan applications, push fast document verification, and secure timely disbursements.
* **Utility \& Regulatory Approvals** 
 : Drive all documentation and registration workflows with local electricity boards (such as KSEB) for initial feasibility approvals, net\-metering allocations, and final site inspections.
* **Government Portal \& Subsidy Management** 
 : Oversee end\-to\-end documentation, portal applications, and compliance filings for central/state solar subsidy programs to achieve zero document rejection rates.
* **Supply Chain \& Field Alignment** 
 : Act as the operational bridge between field sales teams, project engineers, and central inventory. Authorize site dispatch triggers only after ensuring full commercial and documentation clearance.
* **Data \& SLA Tracking** 
 : Maintain absolute data integrity across CRM and operations dashboards. Track and optimize operational metrics, including time\-to\-dispatch, utility approval cycle times, and overall project turnaround times (TAT).
* **Metrics you will own** 
 : Revenue, TAT for financial closure, Outstanding collections
* **Metrics you will be tracking** 
 and influencing the org: Dispatch \& Installation TAT, Overall project TAT, Customer NPS



**What We Are Looking For** 



* **Experience** 
 : 10\+ years of hands\-on operations experience in roles such as Project Operations Lead, Order\-to\-Delivery Manager, Operations Control Tower, or Post\-Sales Operations Lead.
* **High bias for action** 
 : Ability to arrive at the next step, given conflicting constraints around the situation, most of the project situations need quick reaction.
* **Domain Familiarity** 
 : Prior experience in residential rooftop solar, retail banking operations (home/consumer loan processing), telecom/broadband network deployments, or high\-value residential installations.
* **Team Leadership** 
 : At least 4\+ years managing a customer support, back\-office operations, or project tracking team.
* **Process Fluency:** 
 Practical working knowledge in complex processes, typically involving multiple external agencies/portals. Ability to assess process flows and make changes. Ability to root\-cause situations that arise in day to day project flows.
* **Problem Solver** 
 : Highly organized individual with strong troubleshooting abilities who can unblock administrative hold\-ups and maintain strict accountability across teams.
* **Languages** 
 : Fluency in Malayalam and English is mandatory to effectively manage local coordination and cross\-functional operations.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Competitive fixed compensation structure.
* Performance bonuses linked to operational velocity, turnaround times, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* A high\-impact role driving the core operational backbone of a fast\-growing residential clean\-tech business.
